sections.heading: What Is StudioDash?
paragraphs: StudioDash is a developer analytics and business dashboard from [BarkinMad Studios](/about), designed for independent developers and small studios who want a clearer view of their apps and the business behind them.

It brings supported information from the services you already use into one native workspace, helping you spend less time moving between dashboards and more time understanding what is happening across your portfolio.

sections.heading: Built for Independent Developers
paragraphs: StudioDash is designed for solo developers, independent creators and small studios managing apps, games, websites and the services needed to support them.

It becomes particularly useful as your portfolio grows. What is easy to check for one app can quickly become fragmented when several apps, advertising networks, analytics services and websites are involved.
bullets: Solo developers running their own app business.
Developers using multiple analytics, advertising and website services.

sections.heading: Understand Your App Portfolio
paragraphs: StudioDash brings supported App Store information together so you can monitor multiple products from one workspace. Follow app and release status, downloads, sales, ratings, reviews and other available information without checking every app individually.
Viewing your apps as a portfolio makes it easier to compare performance and decide where your development or marketing attention may be most useful.

sections.heading: Know Where Your Revenue Comes From
paragraphs: App revenue can be spread across sales, purchases, advertising and other services. StudioDash brings supported revenue information together so you can see a wider commercial picture instead of comparing several provider dashboards manually.
Explore revenue over different periods, understand the contribution of supported sources and put your results into the context of the goals you have set for your studio.

sections.heading: Include Your Website in the Picture
paragraphs: Your website, search visibility and analytics can be important parts of growing an app portfolio. StudioDash can bring supported website and search information into the same workspace as your app and revenue data.
This makes it easier to keep an eye on how your wider online presence is performing without treating it as a completely separate part of the business.

sections.heading: Connect the Services You Already Use
paragraphs: StudioDash works with supported developer, advertising, analytics, website and search services. You choose the integrations that are relevant to your studio and StudioDash brings their useful information into a consistent workspace.
Provider dashboards remain available for specialist account management and configuration. StudioDash focuses on giving you a convenient view across those services.

sections.heading: Keep Your Information Ready
paragraphs: On Mac, StudioDash can keep supported provider information updated in the background. Instead of beginning every check-in by refreshing several services, useful information can already be available when you return to the dashboard.
You remain in control and can request fresh information manually whenever you need it. StudioDash also keeps provider health visible so you can identify connections that may need attention.

sections.heading: More Than an Analytics Dashboard
paragraphs: StudioDash is designed around the reality that independent developers are also running a business. Downloads and traffic are useful, but they do not tell you whether your apps are generating enough revenue or moving towards your goals.

By bringing commercial information alongside app and audience performance, StudioDash can provide a more useful starting point for deciding where to spend your time, development effort and marketing budget.

sections.heading: Start at the Level That Fits Your Studio
paragraphs: StudioDash is designed around Free, Pro and Studio plans. Free provides the essentials for monitoring your studio, while Pro and Studio provide additional analytics, reporting and business capabilities for developers who need more detail.
An optional Cloud service can extend StudioDash with supported cloud capabilities where available.

sections.heading: Your Connections, Your Data
paragraphs: StudioDash connects to services that can contain important business information. Security and privacy are therefore treated as core parts of the product.
You choose which supported services to connect, and StudioDash is designed to handle credentials and provider access carefully while keeping the status of those connections visible.

sections.heading: Explore StudioDash
paragraphs: The StudioDash guides explain each part of the product in more detail, from dashboards and App Store analytics to revenue, integrations, reporting, synchronisation and security.
Start with the feature overview for a tour of the main capabilities, or open the complete StudioDash Guide to explore every area.
